# Code of Conduct

## Our Standards

This project is committed to providing a welcoming and professional environment. We expect all interactions related to this repository to be conducted with respect and professionalism.

Expected behavior includes:

- Using welcoming and inclusive language
- Being respectful of differing viewpoints and experiences
- Gracefully accepting constructive criticism
- Focusing on what is best for scientific integrity

Unacceptable behavior includes:

- Harassment, trolling, or personal attacks
- Publishing others' private information without permission
- Other conduct which would be considered inappropriate in a professional setting

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all interactions related to this repository, including issues, discussions, and direct communications with the project team.

## Enforcement

Instances of unacceptable behavior may be reported to the project team at [info@azahardata.com](mailto:info@azahardata.com). All complaints will be reviewed and will result in a response deemed appropriate to the circumstances.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant, version 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/).
